context: Tech demo: interactive shape-morphing timeline that animates transitions between bar, line, area, and scatter chart types over synthetic revenue data, with a scrubber and play/pause control.
first_impression: A cohesive dark-theme demo with a single deliberate accent color and clean layout, but the typographic hierarchy is too flat and the gridlines are nearly invisible against the background.
what_works: The single indigo accent color (#6c8aff) is used consistently across the morph path, scrubber thumb, and active phase indicator — giving the demo a unified palette rather than defaults. The muted axis styling (dark domain lines, gray tick text) keeps chrome from competing with data.
what_doesnt: Gridlines (#1a1a2e on #0a0a1a) are so close in value to the background that they provide almost no spatial reference — a near-invisible element that wastes its position in the visual hierarchy. The title is only marginally larger and lighter than axis labels, leaving no clear entry point for the eye.
